tools.name: list_peptides
tools.description: List and filter peptides (slim fields, cursor pagination). (free)

tools.name: get_peptide_summary
tools.description: Answer-first summary: key takeaway, status, evidence grade, citation count and page URL. (free)

tools.name: get_peptide
tools.description: Full peptide snapshot: identifiers, mechanism, indications, at-a-glance. (free daily allowance, then paid: $0.02 USDC via x402, or 1 credit(s) with X-API-KEY)

tools.name: get_citations
tools.description: Source citations for a peptide. (free daily allowance, then paid: $0.02 USDC via x402, or 1 credit(s) with X-API-KEY)

tools.name: get_trials
tools.description: Clinical/preclinical study rows and published regimen. (free daily allowance, then paid: $0.02 USDC via x402, or 1 credit(s) with X-API-KEY)

tools.name: get_safety
tools.description: Safety, toxicology and pharmacokinetics notes. (free daily allowance, then paid: $0.02 USDC via x402, or 1 credit(s) with X-API-KEY)

tools.name: get_regulatory
tools.description: Regulatory status, UNII, CAS. (free daily allowance, then paid: $0.02 USDC via x402, or 1 credit(s) with X-API-KEY)

tools.name: get_identifiers
tools.description: Identifier crosswalk: UNII, CAS, PubChem CID, InChIKey, molecular formula, ChEMBL ID, INN, ATC codes, with source URLs and a UNII cross-check against openFDA. (free daily allowance, then paid: $0.02 USDC via x402, or 1 credit(s) with X-API-KEY)

tools.name: get_trial_landscape
tools.description: Live ClinicalTrials.gov registry landscape: total studies, counts by phase and by status, active-study count, and the most recent registered trials with NCT links. (free daily allowance, then paid: $0.02 USDC via x402, or 1 credit(s) with X-API-KEY)

tools.name: get_approvals
tools.description: Approval timeline: Drugs@FDA applications with original approval dates and sponsors, DailyMed label set IDs, ChEMBL max phase, first-approval year and curated mechanism of action. (free daily allowance, then paid: $0.02 USDC via x402, or 1 credit(s) with X-API-KEY)

tools.name: get_adverse_events
tools.description: FDA FAERS adverse-event signal: total and serious report counts and top MedDRA reactions with report counts (spontaneous reports, not incidence). (free daily allowance, then paid: $0.05 USDC via x402, or 3 credit(s) with X-API-KEY)

tools.name: get_dossier
tools.description: Everything for one peptide in one call: snapshot, identifier crosswalk, approvals, trial landscape, FAERS signal, PubMed literature counts, citations, studies and safety. (free daily allowance, then paid: $0.05 USDC via x402, or 3 credit(s) with X-API-KEY)

tools.name: search
tools.description: Plain-English question → cited passages quoted from our monographs (extractive, no generation). (free daily allowance, then paid: $0.05 USDC via x402, or 3 credit(s) with X-API-KEY)

tools.name: compare_peptides
tools.description: Side-by-side snapshot of 2-5 peptides. (free daily allowance, then paid: $0.05 USDC via x402, or 3 credit(s) with X-API-KEY)

tools.name: bulk_export
tools.description: Entire corpus as one JSON document. Redistribution requires a Commercial license. (paid: $10 USDC via x402, or 500 credit(s) with X-API-KEY)

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
